reason: The cited evidence does not address graphene incorporation into tungsten-based HEAs, interfacial coatings, thermal conductivity enhancement, or high-temperature mechanical performance of such composites. E1 and E2 discuss coherent nanoprecipitation strengthening in a W-based HEA without graphene; E3 concerns reduced graphene oxide in an ultrahigh-temperature ceramic composite, not a refractory HEA; E4 reports on oxide dispersion in a W alloy, unrelated to graphene or coatings. Thus, none of the key premises are supported by the provided passages.
premises: Graphene nanoplatelets can form a percolating network in a refractory HEA matrix via powder processing and SPS
